question: On BOUNCE (3rd down-close, oversold) setups, does a bigger volume spike (rvol50) mean better bounce follow-through? Expect HIGHER rvol50 = better stop-R (capitulation/absorption), the opposite of the four_pct volume-fade result.
plain: Tests whether a volume spike on a stock's down days (capitulation volume) predicts a better bounce, per abnormal-volume and VSA literature.
